# Method GetBodyRigidGroup

#### GetBodyRigidGroup(ElementId)

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 8, 0, 0)]

```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- |

##### Returns

| --- | --- |
